high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a selfie with a smartphone. The individual has long, wavy hair and is wearing a pink and white striped top. They are holding the phone in their right hand, which is covered by a green phone case. Above the clothing rack, there are two framed posters or artwork pieces mounted on the wall.
